definitions.explanation: Physical punishment inflicted on a person, especially by teachers, coaches, or authority figures. A significant social issue in Japanese education and sports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体罰|たいばつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Corporal punishment in schools is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顧問|こもん}→顧問：16146_komon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{体罰|たいばつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The club advisor was disciplined for corporal punishment.

notes:
Corporal punishment by teachers and coaches has been a recurring social issue in Japan, particularly in school club activities (⟦{部活動|ぶかつどう}→部活動：14539_bukatsudou⟧). It is legally prohibited under the School Education Act ({学校教育法|がっこうきょういくほう}), but incidents continue to be reported. Composed of ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body) + ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧ (punishment).

- {体罰|たいばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ (inflict corporal punishment)
- {体罰|たいばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (receive corporal punishment)
- {体罰|たいばつ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibition of corporal punishment)
